messages.text:
Hello Frank,
 

 We are truly sorry to hear that your seeds were crushed during shipping. Despite the care we take with our shipments, certain incidents can unfortunately occur beyond our control.
 

 Customer satisfaction and the quality of our products remain our top priorities. So, That is why, so that you can fully enjoy your tuberosa milkweed, we will reship the package to you free of charge.
 

 Rest assured that we will notify you by email once the order has been shipped.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
